shortBio.en: Joy Division guitarist who learns to sing after Curtis—and steers New Order onto the dancefloor frost.
shortBio.zh: Joy Division 吉他手，在 Curtis 之后学会唱歌——把 New Order 开上结霜的舞池。

whyHub.en: Joy Division → New Order: grief metabolized into a second band that outlives the first.
whyHub.zh: Joy Division → New Order：悲伤代谢成第二支更长寿的乐队。

body.en: Sumner carries the Manchester bloodline across a silence. Joy Division freezes post-punk into hymns; New Order keeps the pulse and adds club electricity. Same city, same friends, different weather—exactly what Person pages are for.
body.zh: Sumner 把曼城血脉带过一场沉默。Joy Division 把后朋克冻成圣歌；New Order 留下脉搏，加上俱乐部电流。同一座城、同一批朋友、不同天气——正是 Person 页存在的理由。
